# Delta Dental

> Delta Dental provides comprehensive dental insurance plans for individuals, families, seniors, and groups, with tools to find providers, estimate costs, and manage coverage.

Delta Dental serves 80+ million members across multiple plan types including PPO, Premier, DeltaCare, and Medicare Advantage options. The site offers integrated member and dentist portals with digital tools for appointment management, cost estimation, and claims processing.

## Key Topics

- Delta Dental PPO
- Delta Dental Premier
- DeltaCare USA
- Dental Insurance Plans
- Group Dental Insurance
- Medicare Advantage
- Dentist Network
- Cost Estimator
- Employee Benefits

- Plan Comparison
- Affordable Coverage

## Insurance Products

- [Our Insurance Products](https://www.deltadental.com/product): Overview of Delta Dental's insurance product offerings for individuals and families
- [Individual and Family Dental Insurance](https://www.deltadental.com/product/individual-and-family): Individual and family dental plans including PPO, Premier, and DeltaCare options
- [Senior Dental Insurance | Retiree Dental Insurance](https://www.deltadental.com/product/senior-dental-insurance): Senior and retiree dental insurance plans with Medicare and Medigap options
- [Group Dental Insurance](https://www.deltadental.com/group): Group dental insurance options for small businesses and large corporations
- [Employee Dental Insurance | Large Corporation Dental Insurance](https://www.deltadental.com/group/corporation): Dental insurance plans for large employers with multiple coverage options
- [Small Business Dental Insurance Plans](https://www.deltadental.com/group/small-business): Dental insurance plans designed for small business employee benefits

## Member Tools & Resources

- [Delta Dental Member Information](https://www.deltadental.com/member): Member portal hub with dentist finder, cost estimator, and account management tools
- [Dentist Directory | Delta Dental Providers | Dentist Near Me](https://www.deltadental.com/member/find-a-dentist): Search tool to find in-network dentists by location and specialty
- [Dental Procedure Cost Estimator](https://www.deltadental.com/member/cost-estimator): Tool to estimate dental procedure costs and out-of-pocket expenses
- [Delta Dental Mobile App](https://www.deltadental.com/member/mobile): Delta Dental mobile app for iOS and Android with member features and tools
- [Delta Dental Member FAQ](https://www.deltadental.com/member/member-faqs): Frequently asked questions for Delta Dental members about benefits and coverage

## Dentist Network & Provider Portal

- [Delta Dental Dentist Login | Dentist Network Information](https://www.deltadental.com/dentist): Dentist provider portal and network enrollment information for dental practices
- [Join Delta Dental Dentist Network](https://www.deltadental.com/dentist/join-our-network): Information for dentists on joining Delta Dental's 80+ million member network
- [Delta Dental Claims Submission Payer ID and Address Lookup Tool](https://www.deltadental.com/dentist/delta-dental-claims-submission-info-lookup-tool): Claims submission lookup tool with payer ID and address information
- [Delta Dental Dentist FAQ](https://www.deltadental.com/dentist/dentist-faq): FAQs for dentists about network participation and insurance plan details
